title: FBI-UAP-D018, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 2-3, Western United States Event, 2023
doc_notes: This document is a digital rendering created by the FBI in 2026 based on a first-hand account of a UAP sighting from October 2023.

incidents.summary: Digital rendering of a UAP sighting near a sensitive national security site in the western United States.
incidents.quote: a bright, circular object is visible in the sky, featuring a glowing yellow outer ring and a distinct red center.
